title: A compensation that runs, and a write nobody declared
note: Two gaps, one shape: a declaration the system recorded and never acted on. The compensation was prose with four consumers and no performer; declared-output collection saw only the files the contract named and was blind to everything else the tool wrote inside its own scope.

mutations.name: X1_a_compensation_runs_without_anyone_deciding
mutations.rationale: an automatic undo performs an unrequested external action in exactly the case where there may have been nothing to undo

mutations.name: X2_any_answer_authorizes_the_compensation
mutations.rationale: ACCEPT_AS_DONE runs the undo, so the person's decision means nothing whichever way they gave it

mutations.name: X3_an_answer_about_another_task_authorizes_this_one
mutations.rationale: one COMPENSATE answer becomes a general permission to undo anything

mutations.name: X4_a_tool_with_no_undo_is_reported_as_compensated
mutations.find:

mutations.rationale: the fabrication the declaration exists to avoid: an operator's action reported as this system's

mutations.name: X5_the_compensation_borrows_the_runs_grant
mutations.replace:
cap_id = next((c for c in self.capabilities.issued_ids()
                       if c.startswith("cap-")), "")
mutations.rationale: 'may run the thing' and 'may undo the thing' become one authority, so a component tricked into either holds both

mutations.name: X6_the_compensation_report_claims_the_far_side_is_undone
mutations.replace: "establishes": "the external effect has been undone and the external system is now in its prior state"}
mutations.rationale: only the far side knows its own state, and a report that reads like confirmation is the fabrication this whole path avoids

mutations.name: X7_an_unmarked_tool_may_be_used_as_a_compensation
mutations.rationale: an ordinary EXTERNAL tool is run for a purpose its own contract does not describe, and the mark that exempts it from needing an undo stops meaning anything

mutations.name: X8_a_compensation_may_name_a_compensation
mutations.rationale: every undo needs an undo and the regress has no bottom

mutations.name: X9_a_compensation_need_not_be_external
mutations.rationale: the exemption from declaring a compensation leaks to tools that only write inside this system, where an ordinary scoped write is the undo

mutations.name: X10_an_unregistered_compensating_tool_is_tolerated
mutations.rationale: a compensation nothing can run reads as 'this effect has no automatable undo', which is a different and reassuring answer

mutations.name: X11_undeclared_writes_are_not_detected
mutations.rationale: the original defect restored: a tool leaves an extra artifact inside its own scope and the provenance record is silently incomplete

mutations.name: X12_undeclared_writes_are_detected_and_ignored
mutations.rationale: the check exists and nothing consumes it, which is the shape of a defence with no caller
